_comment: Machine-checkable canon for Module 4 (Relay Ticket Triage), enforced by scripts/lint-lessons.mjs. Same contract as Modules 1-3: each assertion resolves a path inside a lesson JSON and compares it to the canonical value (ops: equals, includes). Prose canon lives in curriculum/module-04/<tier>/_OVERVIEW.md; THIS file prevents cross-lesson drift. Canon: ticket ids TKT-####, priorities P1-P4, a 4x4 impact/urgency matrix, queue names from the routing table only.
